name: Pashan
civicNote: Under Pune Municipal Corporation, with two ward representatives.
summary: A mainly residential suburb in west Pune between Baner and Bavdhan. Large parts are taken up by government research and educational campuses.
knownFor: National Chemical Laboratory (NCL), IISER Pune and IITM research campuses
Pashan Lake, a man-made lake that draws migratory birds
The largest hill area within Pune municipal limits
connectivity: Lies off the Mumbai-Bengaluru highway bypass
Pashan Road is the main approach towards the Mumbai-Pune Expressway
Pashan-Sus Road links it to Sus
suits: Residents who want a quieter area with a lot of green space, including people linked to its research institutions.
